create_IBOTHead: create an IBOTHead module for iBOT self-supervised learning with configurable MLP layers and prototype heads
build_CustomSequential: build a CustomSequential module that permutes dimensions for batch normalization layers in multi-dimensional tensors
run_forward_local_views: run forward_local_views on a 2D input tensor to produce class token prototypes for local views
run_forward_global_views: run forward_global_views on a 3D input tensor to produce class and patch token prototypes for global views
test_forward: test the forward method to dispatch between local and global view processing based on input tensor dimensions
